description.value: On-demand 4x4 charter shuttle covering the Sea to Sky corridor between Vancouver and Lillooet, specializing in backcountry drops, trailheads, and adventure destinations year-round. Carries up to 11 passengers; bike rack holds 7+ bikes with roof overflow, but minimum 2-hour booking at $140/hr applies.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: Bike rack holds up to 7 bikes plus roof space; no extra charge

wow_evidence: backcountry drops, trailheads, and adventure destinations year-round; bike rack holds 7+ bikes
